description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for health checks related to persistence, including whether the check is enabled, its timeout, and associated metrics reporter configuration.

classes.name: PersistenceConfig
classes.description: Interface for persistence health check configuration, including methods for checking if enabled, getting timeout, and retrieving metrics reporter configuration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the persistence health check should be enabled.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the persistence health check.

methods.name: getMetricsReporterConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings for the metrics reporter.

inner_classes.name: PersistenceConfigValue
inner_classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration keys and their default values for persistence health check settings.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the configuration key.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path associated with this key.
